description: Providing underutilized lands/properties to suitable investors for optimal utilization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Actions are being taken to dispose the underutilized lands/properties identified under the first phase of the underutilized lands/properties available under the Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation, the Janatha Estates Development Board and Elkaduwa Plantations Limited, which are under the purview of the Ministry of Plantation and Community Infrastructure, to suitable investors as per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 06 02. It has been observed that the underutilized lands/properties that were not included in the first phase continue to exist under the relevant institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to provide the following lands/properties to suitable investors on lease basis for optimal utilization, following the due procurement methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Underutilized lands/properties owned by the Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation, the Janatha Estate Development Board and the Elkaduwa Plantation Limited, identified under the second phase.

* 	The Mawarala Estate in extent of 40.48 hectares and the Tea Factory situated in the Matara District belonging to the Tea Shakthi Fund.

* 	The 1,541 hectares of underutilized land in the Kondachchi Estate owned by the Sri Lanka Cashew Corporation.
